groups.name: TV shows whose title is also a real U.S. National Park
groups.explanation: Yellowstone, Everglades, Sequoia, and Glacier are all real U.S. National Parks that also share their name with a TV series. Yellowstone (Paramount Network drama), Everglades (1961 NBC adventure series), Sequoia (2014 drama pilot), and Glacier (short-form series) all take their titles directly from iconic American national parks.

groups.name: Lead female characters in Six Feet Under
groups.explanation: Ruth Fisher (Frances Conroy) and Brenda Chenowith (Rachel Griffiths) are central female characters in Six Feet Under. However, Tara Knowles and Fiona Gallagher are not — this group needs a full replacement. Corrected: Ruth Fisher and Brenda Chenowith are indeed Six Feet Under characters. Replacing tile_1 and tile_2 with Six Feet Under female characters: Claire Fisher and Federico's wife Vanessa Diaz are also in the show. Using Ruth Fisher, Brenda Chenowith, Claire Fisher, and Vanessa Diaz as the four tiles for this group.

groups.name: Actors who played series regulars in Sons of Anarchy
groups.explanation: Maggie Siff played Tara Knowles, Katey Sagal played Gemma Teller Morrow, Charlie Hunnam played Jax Teller, and Ron Perlman played Clay Morrow — all series regulars on Sons of Anarchy (FX, 2008–2014).

groups.name: TV shows where the protagonist receives messages or instructions from a supernatural or unexplained source
groups.explanation: Manifest (passengers receive mysterious callings), Wonderfalls (inanimate animal figurines give a young woman instructions), Joan of Arcadia (God appears to Joan as ordinary people and gives her tasks), and Dead Like Me (a teenage girl becomes a grim reaper and receives undead assignments) all center on protagonists who receive unexplained directives from a supernatural or mysterious source they did not choose.
